files.description: This file contains function definitions for handling private record metadata in a CodeDoc system, including normalization and expected analysis identity, as well as functions related to handling large file identities and private keys.
files.role_in_system: This file supports the CodeDoc system by providing essential functions for managing metadata associated with records, ensuring that private keys and identities are handled correctly.

functions.name: normalized_identity_value
functions.description: Return `source[key]` normalized through `_CACHE_KEY_ABSENT_DEFAULTS`. An absent key resolves to its registered absent-default (or `None` when the key has no mapping).

functions.name: expected_analysis_identity
functions.description: Return the run-level cache-identity keys a freshly generated record carries. This is the part shared by every file in a run.

functions.name: expected_max_context_revision
functions.description: Return the per-file truncation cache-identity value, or `None`. It encodes the effective ceiling and head ratio for truncated files.

functions.name: expected_large_file_identity
functions.description: Return the effective-split cache-identity value, or ``None``.

functions.name: _ordered_private_keys
functions.description: Return *registered* in canonical order.

functions.name: carry_private_keys
functions.description: Copy every registered private key present in *source* into *target*.

files.description: The safe_writer.py file contains the SafeWriter class, which is designed for managing live-output writing and the recovery of file results. It includes methods for handling tree states and records, ensuring that file writing is conducted safely while also managing errors effectively.
files.role_in_system: This file supports the overall codebase by providing a robust mechanism for safely writing output to files, managing the state of the data being written, and ensuring that errors are handled gracefully.
